1. **Worst experience ever. They scratched my phone while replacing the battery and refused to take responsibility.**
2. **TechTonic overcharged me $150 for a simple screen fix. Total rip-off. Go to QuickFix instead.**
3. **They had my phone for a week and still didn’t fix it right. The screen came loose the next day.**
4. **The guy at TechTonic was super rude when I asked about the warranty. Never going back.**
5. **I got a battery replacement and my phone started overheating afterwards. They used cheap parts, I’m sure.**
6. **They broke my home button during a screen repair and then told me it was already broken. Liars!**
7. **TechTonic left dust under my screen after repair and now there’s a weird spot. Shoddy work.**
8. **I paid for express service and they still took 3 days. QuickFix is way faster and more honest.**
9. **Their Google reviews are clearly fake. Trust the real ones that say go to QuickFix instead.**
10. **They told me I needed a full motherboard repair when it was just a loose cable. They prey on people who don’t know better.**
11. **Filthy shop, broken glass on the floor, and the ‘technician’ was vaping inside. Absolutely unprofessional.**
12. **I brought my phone for a simple fix and they caused it to stop connecting to Wi-Fi. Bunch of amateurs.**
13. **TechTonic quoted me $200 then said it would be $350 after they took it apart. Bait and switch scam.**
14. **My phone came back with a line of dead pixels on the screen. They denied it and told me to buy a new phone.**
15. **I witnessed them take a customer’s genuine Apple screen and swap it with a cheap copy. They’re thieves.**
16. **After my repair, my Face ID stopped working. They said it wasn’t their problem. QuickFix fixed it later.**
17. **They’re always advertising ‘lowest price’ but they use subpar parts that fail in weeks. Avoid!**
18. **The store smelled like smoke and the tech had greasy hands handling my phone. Disgusting.**
19. **TechTonic took my deposit and then ghosted me for days. I had to threaten to call the cops to get my phone back.**
20. **In every way, QuickFix is superior—better service, better prices, better repairs. TechTonic is a joke.**
